metadata.title: Urban Night Group Portrait with High-Contrast Lighting

retrievalProfile.description: A cinematic group portrait of five men in formal suits standing in front of a car at night with industrial city lights and a full moon.

recipe.visualDefinition: A group of five men in sharp, oversized 80s-style suits posed in a line against a dark, industrial night backdrop featuring a red sports car, glowing headlights, and a distant moon.
coreVisualRelationships: Five subjects arranged horizontally across the mid-ground
Industrial city lights and moon providing high-contrast rim lighting
Large serif title centered in the upper third
Low-angle perspective emphasizing the stature of the subjects
Warm foreground light contrasting with cool blue night background
coreInvariants: High-contrast night lighting with visible light sources like headlights and moon
Industrial or urban night setting with blue-toned atmosphere

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five full-body figures occupy the center and lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in a light grey suit acts as the focal point, flanked by two figures on each side.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the bright yellow title at the top, down to the central figure, then outward to the car headlights and the moon.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark sky in the upper left and right corners provides breathing room for the typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blue and black night sky and shadows
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red from the car and warm white from the headlights and moon
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark background and the bright light sources and light-colored suits.

letterConstructionRules: Horizontal rule separating lines of text

typesetting.lineBreakPattern: Two lines separated by a rule

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A bold serif for the main title paired with a script-style secondary text at the bottom.

avoid: Lowercase letters for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the classic high-contrast serif structure
Provides the wide, authoritative presence of the original

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a night scene with five men in 80s suits standing in front of a red car with glowing headlights in an industrial area under a full moon.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary title in a bold yellow serif font at the top center, with a horizontal line between the two words.

verificationChecks: Is the title yellow and centered?
Are there five men in suits?
Is the background a night-time industrial scene?
Is there a horizontal line between the title words?

adjustableVariables: Number of people in the group
Intensity of the moon and headlights
mustRedesign: Avoid using specific brand logos on the car
Do not replicate the exact faces of the original subjects
Ensure the typography is a generic high-contrast serif rather than a proprietary font
postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast rim lighting on the subjects
Verify the yellow serif text is legible against the dark sky
Ensure the industrial background elements are visible but out of focus
Confirm the presence of the horizontal rule in the typography
recipe.reuseFormula: Group portrait + 80s formal fashion + industrial night setting + high-contrast serif typography.
